900.3.10(426).explanation: Exception RD 426 keeps the lot's 2013 frontage and area as the minimums, sets a 1.2 m side setback and 5.7 m setback from a side lot line on a street, requires 22.0 m from the original street centreline on Bellamy Rd., Scarborough Golf Club Rd., Orton Park Rd. and McCowan Rd., and lets a garage portion sit in a side yard if at least 0.3 m from the side lot line. No prevailing by-laws apply.

900.3.10(69).explanation: Exception RD 69 sets a 12 m front yard setback, 3 m side yard setbacks on each side, a 9.5 m height cap for flat-roofed detached houses where 3 storeys are permitted, an exemption from the platform rules for upper-storey balconies set back at least 6.0 m (or the required setback, if greater), and caps ancillary buildings at 5% lot coverage and 100 m2 total floor area. No prevailing by-laws apply.

900.3.10(509).explanation: Exception RD 509 keeps the lot's 2013 frontage and area as the minimums, requires side setbacks of 1.0 m on one side and 0.5 m on the other with no encroachments, a 6.5 m rear setback, a 50% maximum lot coverage, and the required parking space inside a building. No prevailing by-laws apply.
